content: Pwamwal Wasana Ta Pihikan Momol Bahi ana En Ta Pepek
He Yehoba Natuna alana i miha hot, inoke wasa toto hi wasaan ge ta hago iya kaiwena ta pihikan momol, kaiwena ebo nigeya, nasi ta yale ge ala bwaga ni gan elana.

Houhouwena oya Sainai elana aneloseyau Yehoba wana baaba hi wasaan Mosese elana. Baaba o ana tunahot i gan, ge gamagalau gegewel bolo hi hewa likaan ge nige hi hehenapu-an ali lahi hi pwawa i olaolaek te wali ginol.

Yaa sauga ya Yehoba wana pwamwal wasana iyaka i pamasal elala, pwamwal o ana nuwatu i bwata hot. Inoke ebo pwamwal o ana en ta pek, ga ta ola ge lahi ta lou luwai? He Babala totona pwamwal o i wasaan houwan, ge bolo hi hagowa elana ana tunahot hi wasaan elala.
Ge Yehoba wasa o i patunahot, kaiwena gasisi ge ginol yawiyawi tomaha ge tomaha i ginolil, ge Yayaluwa Bwabwalena wana gabom i guyauan gamagalau elal i ola wana nuwatu.
Yeisu I Tabwa Gamagal Inoke Iya Toematana ge Iya Topowon Bwabwatana
He Yehoba nige aneloseyau i hihilel ge tage panayawi vavaluna nihi logugui-an, toto abwe ni ginol ge kaiwena ha leleli eliyamiu.
Yaa Buki Bwabwalena gamwanaa Same ana toleleli gamagal bala i baek Yehoba elana i ba:

content.text: Gamagal iya hauna ge kaiwena u nuwanuwatu?
Ga i ola ge gamagal u lalabe?
He iyaka u teli kekeisi i minaa aneloseyau gabulaliyaa,
iyaka u pawasawasa ge alana u teli heyan,
ge iyaka u teli bugul gegewel ni logugui-agil.

content: Buki ya i ba Yehoba gamagalau i telel bugul gegewel nihi logugui-agil, ge ana sapu te nige bugul etega i gagan ge tage nige gamagalau nihi lologugui-an. He sauga ya nige ta kikite te gamagalau bugul gegewel hi logugui-agil.

Yaa Yeisu, iya i tabwa gamagal ge kekeisi i minaa aneloseyau gabulaliyaa, ta kite bugul gegewel i logugui-agil. I tabwa gamagal inoke Yehoba wana mulolu bwagabwaga eliyana iya ni yaomal gamagalau gegewel kaiweliya. Lomwan i pwawa ge i yaomal inoke Yehoba iya iyaka i pawasawasa ge alana i teli heyan.

Yehoba bugul gegewel i ginolil ge bugul gegewel iya kaiwena. Iya nuwana natunau nihi gewi ni ahel ge ni pawasawasa-agil, yaka i ba Yeisu ni tabwa gamagal ge lomwan ni pwawa inoke eliyana bosowaina ni tabwa Toematana ge gamagalau ni houwaagil pwamwal nihi pwawa. He i sapu te Yehoba i ginol ola o.
Yehoba i ba Yeisu i tabwa gamagal, kaiwena iya Topwabwabwalena alonau ge bolo i pwabwabwalena-agil Tamaliya maisena. Inoke nige i pupuluwawi te ni awa talinagil ge ni awa nunagil,
yaka ni baek Yehoba elana ni ba:

content.text: “Wam pagan na wasaan taliwau ge nuwau elal;
na tobalagiwa gamagalau wali nogogo elana.”

content: He iya i tabwa gamagal, inoke i ba al i ba, “Nau Yehoba ana mel na teli,” ge i ola al i ba, “Nau te alowau ge Yehoba natunau bolo i pem elau.”

Yehoba natunau bolo o heliya saliya ge bunum, inoke iya al i tabwa saliya ge bunum i ola heliya. I ginol ola o, inoke wana yaomal eliyana Seitani, toto wana gasisi i gan yaomal ana labi elana, i apapanak-an,
ge gamagalau i sokalil, heliya yawaliliya ana sauga yayapona yaomal lovakunina i paloloyowan-agil.
He i tunahot te Yeisu nige aneloseyau ali tolaba i oola, yaa iya Abalahama tubutubunau ali tolaba.

Inoke heiya te kaiwena ge bugul gegewel elal iya ni ola ya te talinau ge bosowaina ni ola wali topowon bwabwatana. Iya i tabwa topowon bwabwatana toto gamagalau i atilomwan-agil, ge Yehoba wana tuwalali i ginol paolaolaek, inoke iya gamagalau wali gegi i yakil yoho.
He iya lawakik ge lomwan i pwawa, inoke iya bosowaina gamagalau bolo lawakik hi pwapwawa ni label.
